title: insilicoPCR
description: Portable desktop and command-line application for in silico PCR against genome assemblies (FASTA) and sequencing reads (FASTQ), with realistic amplicon calling (primer orientation, product size limits, and weighted 3'-end mismatch assessment), qPCR probe support, read-level calling and read extension for FASTQ input, a check of every input file before the run, consolidated TSV and HTML reports, and a synthetic gel visualizer.
